name: 25 South (Hubtown / Wadhwa), Prabhadevi
address: Yadav Patel Lane, off Veer Savarkar (S.V.S.) Road, near Siddhivinayak Temple, Prabhadevi, Mumbai 400025
amenities: Mini theatre, multipurpose indoor games room
Party hall with outdoor lawn, outdoor barbecue spaces
Open-air amphitheatre, themed garden, meditation corner
Children's play area, senior citizens' area
description: A sea-facing luxury development on a 5.3-acre plot in Prabhadevi, designed by Hafeez Contractor, with large 3, 4 and 6 BHK homes (typically four per floor) in towers of up to 47 habitable floors above a 10-level podium. It is a Hubtown-group project (owned by 25 South Realty Ltd); the Wadhwa Group co-marketed it as development manager. It has drawn several large registered deals, including Rs 127 crore for the top three floors of one wing in 2018.
notes: Developer: Gulf News (2018) and DNA (2018) describe 25 South as a Wadhwa Group and Hubtown project. A Hubtown NSE filing (Aug 2025) says the project is owned by 25 South Realty Ltd and proposed for amalgamation with Hubtown Ltd. A 2021 report seen only in search snippets (not verified) said Hubtown and Singapore's Rising Straits Capital own it, with Wadhwa as development manager since 2015; Oaktree Capital was also reported to have invested. Recent registrations name it 'Hubtown Twenty Five South North', so developer is set to hubtown. Towers: sources give two 57-storey towers, three towers of 55 floors, or South/Central/North towers of G+10P+47; DNA confirms floors 45-47 are the top three floors of one wing, so floors_max = 47 habitable. MahaRERA IDs come from listing sites and were not checked on the MahaRERA portal: P51900006860 (lower floors) and P51900011418 (11th-47th floors) for the earlier Wadhwa-marketed wing(s), and P51900030600 and P51900030729 for later Hubtown phases. Possession: listings range from Nov 2025 (PropTiger) to Dec 2026 (Housiey, RERA date); Housiey says the OC will be applied for near possession and construction is about 95% complete (Sep 2026). Land: 5.3 acres (Gulf News, 'open and slum-free', clear title); Housiey says 5.11 acres. Construction World has reported Hubtown awaiting approvals for a 60+ storey five-star hotel on the same plot (date not seen). Launch: PropTiger gives Dec 2015 (used) and Housing.com Jan 2016 for the Wadhwa-marketed phase (38 launched units), and Housing.com Mar 2016 for the Hubtown 11th-47th floors phase (search snippets). No launch price was found; the earliest price is Square Yards' Oct 2019 asking of about Rs 60,800/sq ft carpet. PropNewsTime counted 3 registered deals in Feb 2024. ADDED (Nov 2026 top-up): Hubtown's NSE filing (26 Aug 2025) describes a ~5.5-acre FREEHOLD plot, about 1 million sq ft of sale area in 3 towers, one tower already completed and handed over, the other two in advanced construction with completion expected in FY27, all approvals including MahaRERA in place, units of 1,565-18,000 sq ft, about 93% sold, interiors by Bobby Mukherji & Associates, landscaping by Design Cell, and over 30 amenities across about 1,20,000 sq ft. It says the metro station is 1 minute away. No OC date is given, so oc_received is left out. Square Yards (Nov 2026): 371 units, 113 launched and 109 booked as of Nov 2025 (used for units_sold), 'partially ready to move', possession Dec 2026; its construction updates conflict (100% structure in Nov 2025 vs 84% in Mar 2026). transactions_12m (11) is Square Yards' Nov 2025-Oct 2026 count. Rents: Square Yards shows live 3 BHK and 4 BHK rental listings (see rental_points), so some completed-tower units are leased out.

price_points.note: Computed: over Rs 127.49 Cr divided by 20,989 sq ft carpet for the top three floors (45-47) of one wing; stamp duty over Rs 6.37 Cr. Registration date not stated. A bulk top-floor purchase, so not a typical unit rate.

price_points.source_name: Square Yards (Wayback Machine snapshot, last updated 18 Oct 2019)
price_points.note: Computed from asking prices: 3 BHK of 1,464 sq ft at Rs 8.90 Cr (about Rs 60,790) and 4 BHK of 1,981 sq ft at Rs 12.33 Cr (about Rs 62,240). 1,464 sq ft is the RERA carpet size on PropTiger. Status: advanced-stage construction. The earliest price found; no 2015-2016 launch price was found.

Computed: about Rs 113 Cr divided by about 19,922 sq ft for five units (a duplex on floors 45-46 plus four 45th-floor flats) bought by Devvrat Developers, registered 28 Nov 2022. Realty+ called the area 'built-up'; Ghar.tv does not give a basis. Single 3,355 sq ft units went for Rs 19.45 Cr (about Rs 57,970/sq ft).

The most expensive Prabhadevi apartment sold in Feb 2024: Rs 29.22 Cr at Rs 73,717/sq ft in 'Hubtown 25 South'. That implies 3,965 sq ft, which matches the month's 'largest carpet area sold', so the basis is taken as carpet.

price_points.source_name: Square Yards registered sales (Wayback Machine snapshot, 6 Aug 2024)
price_points.note: Computed: Rs 17.41 Cr / 2,408 sq ft, registered Jul 2024. The same month's other registrations vary widely: Rs 18.72 Cr/2,392 sq ft (about Rs 78,300), 13.25/1,934 (68,500), 9.42/2,041 (46,200), 6.92/1,934 (35,800) and 9.28/3,780 (24,600). The low ones may be landowner, rehab or non-standard units.

price_points.note: Computed: Rs 18.57 Cr divided by 222.13 sq m (about 2,390 sq ft) carpet, in Hubtown Twenty Five South North, bought by Nadiadwala Grandson Entertainment. The second unit, Rs 18 Cr for about 2,382 sq ft, works out to about Rs 75,600/sq ft.

Computed: 4 BHK 2,142 sq ft carpet at Rs 23.56 Cr all-inclusive (about Rs 1.10 lakh/sq ft); other units range from about Rs 1.10 to 1.37 lakh. All-inclusive prices (incl. charges and possibly parking/GST), so higher than registered agreement values.

Average registered rate of 11 sales from Nov 2025 to Oct 2026 (gross Rs 310 Cr). Listed registrations were 1,662-3,939 sq ft across the North, North B, Central and B wings. Asking averages: Rs 82,450 (Dec 2025), 61,150 (Mar 2026), 96,650 (Jun 2026), 104,500 (Sep 2026).

news.title: Man buys three full floors in Prabhadevi building for Rs 127 cr
news.summary: Welspun Group MD Rajesh Mandawewala buys floors 45-47 of a 25 South wing, 20,989 sq ft carpet, for over Rs 127.49 crore.

news.title: Devvrat Developers Purchases Five Luxury Homes in 25 South, Prabhadevi in South Mumbai For INR 113 Crores
news.summary: Raigad-based Devvrat Developers registers five units (a 45th-46th floor duplex and four 45th-floor flats) for about Rs 113 crore on 28 Nov 2022, with 11 car parks.

news.title: Prabhadevi real estate market trends for February 2024
news.summary: Hubtown 25 South had Prabhadevi's costliest sale of the month (Rs 29.22 crore at Rs 73,717/sq ft) and its largest carpet area (3,965 sq ft), with 3 deals in Feb 2024.

news.title: Brief details of 25 South, Prabhadevi (Hubtown presentation filed with NSE)

news.title: Hubtown to merge promoter entities, boost assets and cut debt
